newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease as uncertainty persists.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease as uncertainty persists.

text.p: Slovenian shares dropped 1.88 percent on Tuesday and traders said the market was expected to continue sliding until at least the end of this week.
"The uncertainty on the market will prevail until banks clarify the costs of custodian accounts and the amount of money they will be able to handle," said Crt Jakhel, a trader at brokerage Nika.
The central bank three weeks ago ordered foreign investors to open custodian accounts with local banks if they wanted to trade in Slovenian securities. Details of the exact procedures remain sketchy.
* The SBI index fell 26.52 points to 1,385.69.
* Overall 10 shares fell, two rose and 14 were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active share, falling 1.95 percent to 57,850 tolars on volume of 436 shares, for total turnover of 25.7 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
